_comment: Photo provenance for Taste of Colombia. All Wikimedia Commons, CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA. Every image visually opened and checked before being accepted. Two dishes (Sobrebarriga, Pollo Sudado) and two prep shots (Arroz con Pollo, Lentejas) had no dedicated Colombian-tagged Commons photo available after exhaustive search -- see notes below for the honest substitution made in each case.

photos.prep_note: Cropped to the bowl of hogao sauce only.
Colombian broth with corn and carrot -- cropped to remove decorative photo border.

photos.prep_file: File:Plato con trozos de mandioca hervida en la mesa.jpg
photos.prep_note: Boiled yuca (mandioca/cassava, same root) chunks -- Argentine source photo, same ingredient. Cropped to remove background clutter.
Close crop on the chicken/rice/pepper/carrot mixture from a second, distinct Commons photo of the same dish (different photographer than the dish shot).

photos.dish_file: File:01 Stewed Beef Carne Guisada - El Sabor Del Taco Truck.jpg
photos.note: No confirmable dedicated Sobrebarriga photo exists on Wikimedia Commons after exhaustive search (only hit: 'Sobrebarriga y tamal de Guapi en Queareparaenamorarte', a blurry shared-plate shot where the sobrebarriga portion could not be visually confirmed with confidence -- rejected per the visual-verification rule). Used a shredded/chunked beef-in-tomato-sauce photo (Tex-Mex carne guisada, native res only 640x480) as an honest visual stand-in for 'sliced flank steak folded through a tomato-based sauce, served with rice and plantain' -- and a clean raw flank steak photo for prep, since step 1 literally starts with a whole flank steak. Recommend re-sourcing the dish photo if a better Colombian-specific one surfaces later.

photos.prep_file: File:Preparación de guiso de lentejas con verduras y caldo de carne en cocina doméstica argentina.jpg
photos.note: Lentejas guisadas is common across Latin America with near-identical preparation; no Colombia-specific tagged photo exists on Commons. Used Argentine guiso de lentejas photos (same lentil-carrot-onion-tomato base). The prep photo's pot may include a few stray meat pieces from the source recipe -- the Colombian version in this bundle is meat-free; alt text does not claim otherwise.

photos.dish_note: Bone-in chicken in tomato-achiote sauce with rice and patacones, photographed at a restaurant in Coveñas, Sucre, Colombia. Cropped to the chicken plate, removing background clutter.
photos.prep_note: Generic onion/garlic/tomato sofrito sauteing -- the closest available Commons photo to 'aromatics building the braising sauce'; includes carrot/celery not in this recipe's ingredient list.
Whole soaked-and-topped cake in its pan, pre-slicing -- used in place of an unavailable 'poked with holes, pre-soak' shot.
